children: T3 Defense terminated its acquisition of a 60% stake in Project 35 through a mutual Cancellation Agreement signed on Aug 28, 2026. The equity interest was returned to the seller, while 168,479 T3 Defense shares and a $1.25 million 12% note due Jul 5, 2027 were returned and canceled. All parties released one another from claims, including T3 Defense's obligation to fund Project 35. The companies may explore a joint venture or product purchases going forward.
: Unwind acquisition and release funding obligations
